name: Elastic Morph Button
description: Button whose SVG background outline squishes inward on press and snaps back with an elastic overshoot on release, with color changes on hover.
contents: Single button with a label and a morphing SVG shape behind it
behavior: Pressing morphs the background path to a squished shape
Releasing springs back with an elastic cubic-bezier transition
Hover swaps text and fill colors
Leaving the button resets the shape
editableByProps: Label text, text and fill colors for rest and hover, border stroke and width, button size

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the button corner shape or squish depth

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Path morph relies on the CSS d property transition, which is not supported in Safari
